name: Corn Chowder
description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and celery.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté for 5 minutes in a large heavy pot.
Add onions and celery; cook until transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper; cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes; cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup
